item.coloph: yeke bari nirvan-u sudur kitad-ača orčiγuluγsan egün-i , kitad-un ubadini wang pha ba bsun kiged , nom-un sitügen bariγči sayin oyutu-luγ-a dalai-yin ayimaγ neretü kelemürči orčiγul-un nayiraγuluγad orusiγulbai , kundga odser manǰusri mergen pandita-dur dulduyidču , mongγol-un kelen-dür garm-a dubsang orčiγulbai .

item.mng: qutuγ-tu yeke bari nirvan-u yeke kölgen sudur
item.coloph: yeke nirvan-u sudur / kitad-ača orčiγuluγsan egün-i, kitad-un ubadini vangphaba bsuγ kiged, nom-un sitügen / bariγči sayin oyutu-luγ-a dala-yin ayimaγ ner-e-tü kelemeči orčiγul-un nayiraγuluγad / orosiγulbai. künga odǰêr manǰusiri mergen baṇḓiḓa-tur dulduyidču , mongγol-un kelen-dür / garm-a dunboyig orčiγulbai . , . maṃ ga-a laṃ. , .
